Ability to analyze and profile data effectively

Experience with big data technologies like Hadoop or Spark
resume_tips: Highlight relevant coursework or projects in data engineering
Emphasize any internships or practical experience with data tools
Showcase skills in programming languages relevant to data processing
Include any experience with cloud platforms or data analytics tools
Mention teamwork or collaborative projects that demonstrate problem-solving
red_flags: Preference for candidates currently enrolled in a relevant degree program
Limited experience in data engineering may be a disadvantage
